tr: Your top is really pretty. / Thanks! It's from the market.
Is the soto good? / It's good, but a bit spicy.
You're sleepy, huh? / Yeah, I went to bed at two last night.
Shall we go to the beach tomorrow? / Sure, let's just go to Kuta beach.
Would you like some orange juice? / Yes, please.
Good morning, Mr. Budi. / Good morning, Emma. How are you?
Hi, Rina! How are you? / Fine, thanks. You?
Thank you so much, Mrs. Sari. / You're welcome, Emma.
Sorry, sir! / That's OK.
Excuse me, sir, I need to get past. / Oh, go ahead.
I'm heading home now. / Goodbye! Get home safe.
Good evening, ma'am. Do you have a room free? / Good evening. Yes, we do, sir.
What's your name? / My name is Emma.
Where are you from? / I'm from the US.
Excuse me, sir, do you speak English? / Just a little.
How long have you been in Indonesia? / Only a week so far.
I'm from Surabaya. And you? / I'm from the US, but I live in Bandung.
How old are you? / I'm thirty years old.
Are you married? / Not yet, ma'am.
Who's this? / This is my older sister, Rina.
Where do your parents live? / My parents live in Medan.
Where are the kids? / They're at Grandma's.
Where shall we eat? / Let's just go to that warung.
How much is it, ma'am? / Twenty-five thousand.
How much is it all together? / Eighty thousand all together, ma'am.
Do you have small bills, sir? / Sorry, I only have a hundred thousand.
Can I pay by card? / Sorry, cash only.
May I have your number? / Sure. Here's my phone number.
What time is it? / It's three o'clock.
What time is the meeting? / Half past two.
What day is it today? / Today is Friday.
What's the date today? / Today is the seventeenth.
Are you working tomorrow? / No, tomorrow is Sunday.
What would you like to order, ma'am? / One chicken satay and one sweet iced tea, please.
For here or to go? / To go, please.
Have you eaten? / Not yet. Let's eat!
Can I have the check, please? / Sure, just a moment, sir.
Would you like some chicken satay? / Sorry, I don't eat meat.
How much is this, ma'am? / Thirty thousand.
Can you go any lower, sir? / Twenty-five thousand, then.
Do you have another color? / Yes, a blue one and a black one.
Looking for anything, ma'am? / I'm just looking, thanks.
Can I try it on? / Sure, the fitting room is over there.
Go take a shower first, OK? / I've already showered, Mom.
Where are you going? / To the warung. I haven't eaten yet.
What time do you get up? / I get up at six.
Where's the bathroom, ma'am? / Next to the kitchen.
What are you doing? / I'm cooking fried rice.
Excuse me, sir. Where is the station? / Go straight, then turn right.
Is there a pharmacy near here? / Yes, in front of the mosque.
Excuse me, where's the restroom? / At the back, ma'am, on the left.
Is the Ubud market far from here? / It's not far. Ten minutes on foot.
Is there a post office here? / Sorry, there isn't one.
Sorry, sir, I'm lost. / Where are you going, miss?
Where are you going for the holidays? / I want to go to Bali.
Where to, ma'am? / To the airport, please.
Stop here, please. / All right, ma'am. Thirty thousand.
Good evening. Do you have a room available? / Yes, sir. For how many nights?
What time does the train leave? / At seven in the morning, but the train is often late.
From Ubud to Kuta, how long does it take to get there? / About an hour by car.
Why didn't you come to work? / I'm sick, ma'am. I have a fever.
What's wrong, Ayu? / I have a bad headache.
Do you have cough medicine? / Yes. Take it three times a day, okay?
Could you call a doctor, please? My friend has fainted. / Okay, wait a moment.
May I sit here? / Please do, ma'am.
Sir, I lost my wallet. / Where did you last see it, ma'am?
Where do you work? / I work in an office, in Jakarta.
Where do you work, sir? / I work at a bank, in Surabaya.
Are you working yet? / Not yet, I'm a college student.
Sari, can you help me? / Sorry, I'm busy right now. Later, okay?
Want to go out tonight? / I can't. There's an exam tomorrow.
Is Mr. Budi in? / He's in a meeting until three.
Is your house big? / No, it's small. But I'd like a big house with a garden.
That house is big, isn't it? / Yes, that's Mr. Agus's house.
Which one is your friend? / That one, the tall person.
Do you want the red one or the blue one? / Just the blue one.
What book is that? / This is the book I bought in Bandung.
Do you like living here? / I love it. Indonesians are friendly.
I'm hungry. / Let's go eat fried rice.
Do you want to go out? / Maybe later. I'm tired.
What's your hobby? / I like swimming and reading.
What's wrong, Rina? / My little brother isn't home yet. I'm worried.
Do you want to go out on Sunday? / Sure! Let's go to the beach.
Why are you sad? / I miss my family in the US.
Where are you from? / From the US.
What's your name? / My name is Emma.
Whose car is this? / Mr. Joko's car.
Where are you going, Fajar? / To the market. Do you want to come?
I'd like that bag. / Which one? The black one?
Tea or coffee, ma'am? / Just tea, thank you.
Excuse me, ma'am, what does this word mean? / It means water.
I'm not coming tomorrow. / Why?
Are you married? / Not yet.
Ma'am, here's my assignment. / Sorry, I'm not a teacher. I'm a college student.
I'm heading home. / Don't go! It's still early.
Do you want to eat? / Thanks, I'm not hungry.
Hi, what's your name? / Putri. You?
How old are you? / I'm twenty-five years old.
Where do you live? / I rent a room near campus.
Are you hungry? / Nope, I've already eaten.
How are things? / Good. How about you?
What are you up to? / Watching a movie. Why?
Five hundred thousand. / How come it's so expensive?
Here's your coffee. / Thanks!
Sorry I'm late. / No problem.
Your cooking is delicious. / Oh, it's nothing special. Have some more!
Wow, you're really good! Have you played guitar long? / Only two years.
How about we have dinner at the beach? / Good idea!
Here, I brought you an umbrella. / You're so kind. Thank you!
Your child is very smart. / Thank you. She loves reading.
Your home is so cozy. / Thank you. Please, have a seat.
Batik looks great on you. / Thanks! This batik is from Solo.
Your Indonesian is really fluent! / Not fluent yet, I'm still learning.
Your presentation was excellent. / Thank you for the compliment, sir.
This is sayur asem I made myself. / It's delicious! Could I have the recipe?
I ran ten kilometers. / Wow, awesome!
The report is finished, sir. / Good work! Thank you.
You still look so young! / Oh, you're too kind.
Good morning, ma'am. How are you? / Wow, you already speak Indonesian!
You're really good at the guitar. / Oh, not really. I'm still learning.
Sorry I'm late. / That's OK. You look beautiful tonight.
You look handsome in that shirt. / Thanks! It's a new shirt.
You have a sweet smile. / Oh, you smooth talker! But thanks.
Why are you smiling? / You always make me laugh.
I like your style. Where did you buy the top? / At the market, it was cheap!
You have beautiful eyes. / That's sweet of you.
You have a nice voice. Do you like singing? / Yes, since I was little.
I love talking with you. / Me too. You're fun!
I like you. / Seriously? I like you too.
Excuse me, can I introduce myself? I'm Ryan. / Sure. I'm Putri.
Can I have your number? / Sure. I'll send it to you.
Want to get coffee sometime? / Sure, I'd love to.
Got plans Saturday night? / Nothing yet. Why?
I'd like to see you again. / I'd really like that!
Are you seeing anyone? / Thanks, but I'm seeing someone.
Want to have dinner together tomorrow? / Let's see.
I have a crush on you. Will you go out with me? / Thanks, but let's just be friends, OK? You're very kind.
Could I get your number? / Sorry, I'm not interested.
Hey, Budi! Where are you going? / To the market. Want to come?
The shop is closed on Sundays. / Oh, I see. Thank you.
Your Indonesian is really good! / Ah, I'm still learning.
Here's a little gift from Bali. / Wow! Thank you so much!
What's wrong? / Ouch! My foot hurts.
Come on, let's eat now! / Let's go! I'm really hungry.
Oh my God! My wallet's gone! / Calm down, look in your bag.
Oh my goodness, you're soaking wet! / Yes, it was pouring earlier.
The train is two hours late. / Uh-oh! We might be late.
Where's the key? / There you go, here it is! Under the table.
Hey, have you eaten? / Not yet. Let's eat!
Let's go eat bakso! / Sure, let's go!
We have tomorrow off! / Hooray!
My mother is well again. / Thank goodness.
The cat is hungry and tiny. / Poor thing! Let's feed it.
I have three kids already. / No way! You're so young!
Oops! Sorry, I spilled the coffee. / That's OK.
I'll pick you up at seven, OK? / Great!
Hello? Is this Rina? / Yes, this is Rina. Who's this?
Hope you get well soon. / Amen. Thank you.
How are you, sir? / Fine, thank God.
Can you come tomorrow? / God willing.
This is my boyfriend, Andi. / Ooh! Finally!
Ugh, I forgot to bring an umbrella. / Just use mine.
Want to try durian? / Eww! The smell!
It costs one million. / What? One million?
Let's meet at the station at five. / OK. See you later.
I got a new job! / Congratulations! That's great!
